title: Escalation
description: Where a case goes when it needs a person. `reply_via` is bounded by the client exactly as actions are, and `none` is a real option — a vendor may promise no reply, and saying so is better than silence. There is deliberately no inbound channel on the customer's machine. Fields in `require` are collected as ordinary probes, with consent, and validated locally before a case is opened.

target.description: The vendor's own routing target; passed through untouched.
